message.content: {"q1_human_microarray_expression_profiling":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Study type: transcription profiling by array; Technology: Array assay; cRNA synthesis, human U133 plus 2.0 GeneChip hybridization; Assay by Molecule: RNA assay.","justification":"Human RNA from tissue was profiled using Affymetrix U133 Plus 2.0 microarrays, satisfying human microarray expression profiling criterion."},"q2_target_disease":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Title: 'EGR4 is a master gene responsible for fertility in cryptorchidism'; Description: RNA isolated from testicular biopsies of cryptorchid boys; Disease field: Not related to ALS/FTD.","justification":"The study concerns cryptorchidism (testicular fertility), not amyotrophic lateral sclerosis or frontotemporal dementia."},"q3_human_cns_tissue":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Samples: Organism part: total testicular; Description: testicular biopsies of cryptorchid boys.","justification":"Tissue sampled is testis, not brain or other CNS tissue."},"q4_non_clinical":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Description: Whole testicular tissue biopsies collected and processed for RNA isolation; no mention of cell lines or animal/disease models.","justification":"Samples are primary human tissue biopsies rather than patient-derived in vitro cell lines or experimental disease models."},"q5_case_control_design":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Description: 'Whole testicular tissue was gained from cryptorchid boys aged 10 Months to 4.5 years as well as from controls of identical age.'","justification":"The study includes affected individuals (cryptorchid boys) and age-matched controls, indicating a case/control design."},"q6_irrelevant_brain_region":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Organism part: total testicular; all sample descriptions refer to testicular tissue.","justification":"Tissue is non-neural (testis) and thus not a brain region affected by ALS-FTD neurodegeneration."},"q7_incompatible_technology":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Study type: transcription profiling by array; Technology: Array assay; Affymetrix U133 Plus 2.0 GeneChip hybridization.","justification":"The technology is microarray-based expression profiling, which is compatible with inclusion (not RNA-seq or proteomics)."},"q8_inclusion_justification":{"justification":"Although the dataset uses human microarray expression profiling and has a case/control design, it is not relevant to ALS-FTD: the disease studied is cryptorchidism and the tissue is testis (non-CNS). Thus it fails the disease- and tissue-related inclusion criteria."},"q9_include_dataset":{"answer":"No"}}

{"q1_human_microarray_expression_profiling":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Study type: transcription profiling by array; Technology: Array assay; 53 Affymetrix miRNA 3.0 arrays (description).","justification":"Human samples (Homo sapiens) profiled using Affymetrix miRNA microarrays (microarray-based expression profiling of ncRNAs/miRNAs)."},"q2_target_disease":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Title and description repeatedly refer to amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS), sporadic ALS (sALS), familial ALS (fALS) and asymptomatic ALS mutation carriers.","justification":"Study specifically investigates ncRNA signatures in ALS patients and mutation carriers, matching the ALS-FTD disease domain (ALS component)."},"q3_human_cns_tissue":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Description: \"We obtained expression profiles of miRNAs as well as other non-coding RNAs (ncRNAs) in the serum of sporadic ALS patients...\"; Organism: Homo sapiens; Organism part: not found.","justification":"Samples are serum (blood-derived), not human brain or CNS tissue. Does not involve CNS tissue relevant to ALS-FTD. "},"q4_non_clinical":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Description indicates sampling from patients and mutation carriers (serum); no mention of patient-derived cell lines or disease models.","justification":"Study uses clinical serum samples from humans rather than in vitro cell lines or experimental disease models."},"q5_case_control_design":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Description: serum ncRNA profiles of sporadic and familial ALS patients and asymptomatic carriers were compared to age- and gender-matched healthy controls; group sizes and comparisons listed.","justification":"Design includes case (ALS patients, mutation carriers) versus control (healthy) comparisons, i.e., a case/control study design."},"q6_irrelevant_brain_region":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Samples are serum per description; no brain regions sampled or reported.","justification":"Because no brain/CNS regions were sampled, the question of irrelevant brain regions does not apply; dataset does not involve any brain region sampling."},"q7_incompatible_technology":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Study type: transcription profiling by array; Technology: Array assay; Affymetrix miRNA 3.0 arrays.","justification":"Data were generated using microarray technology (miRNA microarrays), which is compatible with microarray expression profiling inclusion criteria."},"q8_inclusion_justification":{"justification":"Although this is a human microarray study of ALS with a case/control design and compatible technology, samples are serum (blood-derived) rather than human CNS/brain tissue. Because inclusion requires CNS tissue from regions relevant to ALS-FTD, this dataset should be excluded."},"q9_include_dataset":{"answer":"No"}}

{"q1_human_microarray_expression_profiling":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Study type: transcription profiling by array; Assays and Data: Technology: Array assay; Assay by Molecule: RNA assay; Organism includes Homo sapiens; primary MPNSTs and orthoxenograft passages were selected for gene expression profiling.","justification":"The study used microarray-based transcription profiling of RNA and includes human-derived primary tumor samples."},"q2_target_disease":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Title and description describe malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumors (MPNST) and neurofibromatosis type 1 (NF1); no mention of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) or frontotemporal dementia (FTD).","justification":"The dataset focuses on MPNST/NF1 and therapeutic response, not ALS-FTD."},"q3_human_cns_tissue":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Description: primary MPNSTs were implanted in the sciatic nerve of nude mice; Organism part not listed as brain/CNS; MPNSTs are peripheral nerve sheath tumors.","justification":"Samples derive from peripheral nerve tumors/xenografts (sciatic nerve), not human brain or CNS regions relevant to ALS-FTD."},"q4_non_clinical":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"\"We generated five patient-derived MPNST orthoxenograft models\"; primary tumors and orthoxenograft passages were profiled; models were implanted in nude mice.","justification":"This is an in vivo patient-derived xenograft (orthoxenograft) disease model, which meets exclusion criterion for non-clinical models."},"q5_case_control_design":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Experimental Designs: Not found; Experimental Factors list sample type, nf1-associated, passage, original tumor; no control (healthy) group or case/control comparison described.","justification":"The study compares primary tumors and xenograft passages/treatment responses rather than a case vs healthy control design."},"q6_irrelevant_brain_region":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Samples are MPNST tumors and orthoxenografts in the sciatic (peripheral) nerve; no brain regions sampled.","justification":"Tissues sampled are peripheral nerve/tumor, not brain regions affected by ALS-FTD neurodegeneration."},"q7_incompatible_technology":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Assays and Data: Technology: Array assay; Assay by Molecule: RNA assay; Study type: transcription profiling by array.","justification":"The dataset uses microarray-based RNA expression profiling, which is compatible with inclusion (not RNA-seq or proteomics)."},"q8_inclusion_justification":{"justification":"Exclude: Although this is human microarray transcription profiling, the study is about MPNST (not ALS-FTD), uses patient-derived orthoxenograft disease models (xenografts), samples peripheral nerve/tumor tissue rather than CNS brain regions, and lacks a case/control design; it therefore fails multiple inclusion criteria."},"q9_include_dataset":{"answer":"No"}}

"},"q4_non_clinical":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Source Characteristics: Skin fibroblast; Experimental Factors lists cell type; samples are patient-derived fibroblasts (4 affected, 4 healthy).","justification":"The study uses patient-derived primary fibroblast cells (in vitro), which are non-CNS, patient-derived cell samples."},"q5_case_control_design":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Description: 8 fibroblast samples: 4 SPOAN affected patients and 4 healthy controls.","justification":"The sample set includes affected cases and healthy controls suitable for case/control comparison. (No paired/replicate structure noted.)"},"q6_irrelevant_brain_region":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Organism part: Skin fibroblast (no brain regions sampled).","justification":"No CNS regions are sampled; skin fibroblasts are not regions affected by ALS-FTD neurodegeneration. "},"q7_incompatible_technology":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Technology: Array assay; Study type: transcription profiling by array.","justification":"The platform is array-based expression profiling (microarray), which is compatible with inclusion criteria for microarray datasets. "},"q8_inclusion_justification":{"justification":"Exclude: although the dataset is human microarray expression profiling and has a case/control design, it does not pertain to ALS-FTD (it studies SPOAN) and uses skin fibroblasts (patient-derived in vitro cells) rather than relevant human CNS tissue. These violate inclusion criteria (target disease and CNS tissue) and meet exclusion criteria (patient-derived in vitro cells)."},"q9_include_dataset":{"answer":"No"}}

{"q1_human_microarray_expression_profiling":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Study type: transcription profiling by array; Technology: Array assay; Affymetrix Clariom™ D Assay, human (Affymetrix ref.902923).","justification":"Human samples (Homo sapiens) assayed using an Affymetrix microarray platform for RNA expression profiling."},"q2_target_disease":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Disease: sporadic frontotemporal lobar degeneration, familial frontotemporal lobar degeneration; study title and description reference FTLD and FTLD-TDP, including C9ORF72-familial FTLD.","justification":"The study addresses frontotemporal lobar degeneration (FTLD/FTD). C9ORF72-mediated FTLD is part of the ALS-FTD spectrum, so the dataset pertains to the ALS-FTD disease domain."},"q3_human_cns_tissue":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Organism part: Brodman (1909) area 8; Description: RNA extracted from human frontal cortex area 8.","justification":"Samples are postmortem human frontal cortex (Brodmann area 8), a CNS brain region."},"q4_non_clinical":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Samples: postmortem human frontal cortex area 8 from controls and FTLD patients; no cell line or in vitro model indicated.","justification":"Tissue samples are from patient postmortem brain, not patient-derived cell lines or experimental disease models."},"q5_case_control_design":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Description: controls (n=10), sporadic FTLD-TDP (n=10) and C9ORF72-familial FTLD (n=10); Experimental Designs: disease state design; Experimental Factors: disease.","justification":"Study includes control and disease groups enabling case/control comparisons."},"q6_irrelevant_brain_region":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Description: frontal cortex area 8, “the main area afected in FTLD”.","justification":"The sampled region (frontal cortex, Brodmann area 8) is a region significantly affected in FTLD/FTD and therefore relevant to ALS-FTD spectrum."},"q7_incompatible_technology":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Technology: Array assay; Assay by Molecule: RNA assay; Affymetrix Clariom™ D Assay (microarray).","justification":"The assay is a microarray platform, which is compatible with inclusion (not RNA-seq/proteomics)."},"q8_inclusion_justification":{"justification":"Meets inclusion criteria: human microarray expression profiling of CNS tissue (frontal cortex BA8), disease relevant to ALS-FTD spectrum (FTLD including C9ORF72 cases), case/control design, not an in vitro/model study, and uses compatible microarray technology. Therefore appropriate for inclusion."},"q9_include_dataset":{"answer":"Yes"}}

Clinical history: sporadic FTLD-TDP, Familial FTLD with MAPT/PGRN mutations.","justification":"The dataset includes FTLD/FTD cases (frontotemporal lobar degeneration), which pertains to the FTD side of ALS-FTD spectrum."},"q3_human_cns_tissue":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Organism part: middle temporal gyrus; Technology: Array assay; Assay by Molecule: RNA assay.","justification":"The assay is array-based transcription profiling (microarray), which is compatible with inclusion (not RNA-seq or proteomics)."},"q8_inclusion_justification":{"justification":"This is a human microarray study of temporal cortex including FTLD (FTD) cases and normal controls, with no evidence of in vitro models and using array technology. Description: '...brain tissue from control, high pathological controls, and Alzheimer disease subjects'","justification":"The study explicitly includes Alzheimer's disease cases and is focused on AD-related comparisons."},"q3_human_cns_tissue":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Samples: Organism: Homo sapiens; Organism part: brain; Title: cortex tissue","justification":"Samples are human cortical brain tissue (cortex), which is CNS tissue relevant to AD."},"q4_non_clinical":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Cell type/line: Not found; Sample source: cortex tissue from human subjects","justification":"Samples are post-mortem brain tissue, not patient-derived in vitro cell lines or disease-model systems."},"q5_case_control_design":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Experimental Designs: disease state design; Experimental Factors: disease staging; Disease state/staging: Alzheimer's disease, normal, high-pathological control","justification":"The study has a disease-state (case vs control) design comparing AD, high-pathological controls and normal controls."},"q6_irrelevant_brain_region":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Title: cortex tissue; Organism part: brain","justification":"Cortex (neocortex) is a brain region significantly affected in AD neurodegeneration and is therefore relevant."},"q7_intermediate_phenotype":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Clinical/familial: 'low neurofibrillary tangles and no neuritic plaques, intermediate neurofibrillary tangles and low neuritic plaques, low neurofibrillary tangles and low neuritic plaques'","justification":"Provided clinical staging describes low/intermediate neurofibrillary tangle burden; no samples are annotated as advanced Braak V/VI neocortical-stage AD, so the dataset includes intermediate/low pathology rather than the required Braak V/VI AD cases."},"q8_familial_alzheimer_disease":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Clinical/familial: entries describe tangle/plaque burden only; no indication of familial AD or monogenic cases in metadata or title","justification":"There is no evidence that samples are exclusively familial AD cases."},"q9_incompatible_technology":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Study type: Human - One-color microarray; Technology: Array assay; Assay by Molecule: RNA assay","justification":"The assay is an array-based RNA assay (miRNA array) rather than technologies excluded (RNA-seq or proteomics)."},"q10_inclusion_justification":{"justification":"Although this is a human array-based (miRNA) expression study of relevant cortical tissue with a case/control design, the sample pathology annotations indicate low-to-intermediate neurofibrillary tangle burden and do not report Braak V/VI neocortical-stage AD cases. Per inclusion criterion #7 (only Braak V/VI disease samples accepted), the dataset should be excluded."},"q11_include_dataset":{"answer":"No"}}
